SAI2 onk easygoing but jodi apnar target A/A- thake then-
Quiz + mid and final er mcq part e close to full marks rakhte hobe.
Quiz 1 easy hoy quiz 2 er tulonay, quiz 1 e sir slides theke mcq , t/f same to same tule dey, so quiz 1 e full marks tulte na parle, quiz 2 te full marks tola onk tough karon quiz 2 tricky kore. (Quiz best 1 count kore)
Mid e 5 marks mcq 15 marks written. Written e just point thik rekhe nijer moto explain korlei marks diye dey sir, written e jotoi bhalo likhen na kno sir avg. marking korbe iccha kore, so written er jonno joto kom effort dibe toto better. Baki thake 5 marks (5 mcq), ekhane 5 out of 5 rakhte parle mid e highest mark confirm.
(Written part er jonno sir suggestions diye dibe oikhan thekei ashbe shob, no suggestions for mcq)
Final o similar to mid just final e mcq 10 ta thkbe jeta slide theke same to same tule dibena ektu tricky korbe. So ekhaneo Atleast 9 out of 10 rakhte parle highest mark confirm.
And for other assessments like individual entrepreneurial case, group case study, group report egulate just sir er guidelines ta follow korben karon ekhaneo sir shobaire avg. marking kore joto bhaloi koren na kno.
(Hudai ekta Presentation nibe but oitate kono marks nai)
Lastly, whole section er upor basis kore sir 1/2 grade curve korbe.

I did FIN444 under Zahir Sir (MZIZ) in Summer 2023. Got an A. He is very easygoing and friendly. Make sure you interact with him, answer some of his questions (atleast try), take notes thoroughly and try to have a clear concept about every topic (don't let it slide if you are unsure, ask him and he will help you). The math problems in exams are mainly what he teaches in class and read your notes along with the slides. He is very helpful and if you have a clear understanding of what he teaches in class, you will do very good.
